title: Chapter 398 Unchanging Future
content:
Chapter 398 Unchanging Future

The boundary of the universe, inside the largest ancient house.

Space fluctuates, and Lu Daosheng's figure appears again.

And the time here is just a moment.

But at this moment, Lu Daosheng had already undergone earth-shaking changes.

His eyes were like torch, looking at the universe, his bright eyes were filled with a bit of complexity.

The world is really in danger.

This is also thanks to my student. If it weren't for the Human Emperor, I'm afraid I would have lost it before I even lived this life.

Thinking of the Human Emperor, Lu Daosheng couldn't help but sigh.

The Human Emperor once again extended the life span of the world at the cost of his own life.

He naturally wants to cherish this opportunity.

The Human Emperor is using his actions to tell him not to give up!

Standing there, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and soon made a decision.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng appeared on the boundary of the universe.

An invincible aura poured out, shaking the entire universe's boundary trembled wildly.

Feeling Lu Daosheng's aura, countless powerful people suddenly appeared, all looking at Lu Daosheng.

This powerful human race who came from somewhere seemed to have a little more terrifying aura than just now.

What happened in this short time?

The leaders of all races looked at Lu Daosheng with a lot of thoughts in his heart.

But in a broad sense, they were still happy.

After all, they are now united in the enemy and are grasshoppers on the same boat. How could they be unhappy if their own people are so strong?

"Everyone."

At this time, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded, like the roar of the great way, resounding in the ears of sentient beings.

"In the past, I created a deserted city to protect the universe. Because of me, the world's resources were reduced sharply and the collapse was imminent."

Although the collapse of the world is inevitable, Lu Daosheng's actions back then did exacerbate the collapse of the world a lot. Lu Daosheng generously admitted this.

Immediately afterwards, Lu Daosheng continued, "Today, I, Lu Daosheng, will definitely not watch the world and the spirits of sentient beings be destroyed."

"If you believe me, you will continue to guard here. When the time is ripe, I will definitely take you through this crisis!"

Lu Daosheng's voice kept echoing from the boundaries of the universe.

The sentient beings looked at Lu Daosheng's figure at this moment, all of whom were stunned and speechless.

After a long time, an old creature looked at Lu Daosheng and stuttered: "Senior, is it the lord of the wasteland city in the primitive era?"

The primitive era was an era when the universe had just been born and was in chaos.

And it was in such an era when demons were dancing, a terrifying existence swept across everything, created an arrogant desert city, and suppressed an era.

No creature dared to mention that person's name, but he just called him the Lord of the Desert City in a subtle way.

Now that I saw someone calling myself that, several old monsters who had survived for endless years could not sit still.

"Oh? Do you recognize me?"

Lu Daosheng looked slightly sideways and looked at the talking creature. He was a little surprised. He didn't expect that some of these younger generations would recognize him.

Hearing that Lu Daosheng admitted his identity, the old monsters immediately took a breath, and then knelt down to Lu Daosheng with a respectful expression and a little fear.

Seeing this, the other living beings also knelt down one after another.

After all, these old monsters are basically the strongest group of people in the universe today. They are all leaders of a group. Their leaders have all bowed down. What reason does these descendants have to not bow?

"Dear City Lord, my ancestor, I have lived in the deserted city for a while and have enjoyed the protection of the City Lord. I will never forget the City Lord for the rest of my life."

The elderly creature bowed deeply and sighed.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng immediately understood.

So that's it.

At this time, everyone finally knew some of Lu Daosheng’s origin, and their eyes were filled with awe.

"Have you all recorded what I said?"

Lu Daosheng looked at everyone and asked.

Hearing this, the sentient beings responded quickly, "Senior, we have recorded it."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng nodded with satisfaction.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng's palm spread out and an illusory ancient city slowly emerged.

Immediately afterwards, a desolate and ancient aura floated out.

The deserted city!

There are many deserted cities created by Lu Daosheng, but this one is the first deserted city in the world and is unique.

Looking at the deserted city floating in his hand, Lu Daosheng no longer hesitated and threw it out directly towards the boundary of the universe.

Rumble!

The terrifying power suddenly shocked the entire universe's boundary and made a loud roar.

After a long time, the movement and stillness dissipated.

I saw a huge giant city standing quietly on the boundary of the universe, suppressing the world!

......

"Everything has cause and effect, nothing exists forever, and the collapse of the world is inevitable."

After leaving the boundaries of the universe, Lu Daosheng was thinking about this issue.

But no matter how you think about it, Lu Daosheng felt a headache.

Because after thinking about it, he couldn't think of how to change this fact.

"Time flies so fast."

At this moment, Lu Daosheng had to sigh that no matter what he did, whether he was doing it or working hard, time would flow like water.

"time?"

At this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly had a flash of inspiration, and he seemed to have thought of an opportunity.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng stopped.

"The collapse of the world happens in the future, so can I keep the current situation of the world in the present?"

In order to verify his conjecture, Lu Daosheng held the void in his hand and pulled it hard.

Hurry!

A vast river spans ancient and modern times, rushing from Lu Daosheng.

The long river of time!

The timeline of the whole world.

Compared with the long river of time that I have ever come into contact with, the long river of time is like a baby, but it has only some fur.

Seeing the long river of time in front of him, Lu Daosheng did not hesitate and stepped directly into the long river of time.

The river was turbulent, and Lu Daosheng was calm and calm, ignoring the erosion of time, and going down the river.

The future is full of variables.

Even Lu Daosheng only saw some illusory images downstream of the long river of time.

But as Lu Daosheng went further and further, a trace of divination suddenly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng. There was no way ahead, and here was the end of the long river of time.

No matter how the future changes, the ending of this world remains unchanged.

At this moment, even Lu Daosheng felt a deep despair.

He held his hands tightly, his eyes full of reluctance.

Why can't the world have another ending?

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng walked back to the starting point.

He originally wanted to maintain the world to the present, so that the world would not collapse.

But in this way, the world still has no future.

Without a future, the world is incomplete.

Such a world is probably just a lifeless world, not what Lu Daosheng expected.
